intro.title: Event Handling
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple interactive button that responds to user clicks. You'll learn how to handle events in Vue by using the v-on directive to listen for user actions. The core concept is event handling, which allows your application to react to user input like clicks. You'll work with Vue's template syntax and methods to update the page content dynamically when the button is pressed.
intro.usecase: Event handling is fundamental to every interactive Vue application, from simple form submissions to complex dashboard interactions. In real products, you'll use event handling when users click buttons in e-commerce checkouts, toggle filters in data tables, open modal dialogs, or submit search queries. As a Vue developer, you'll constantly wire up @click, @submit, and @input handlers to make UI components respond to user actions, creating the responsive experiences modern web applications require.
